quota_project_id.title: Quota project ID
quota_project_id.description: Specify a different project ID to account for quota and billing of Fivetran query workload

secret_key.description: Private key of the customer service account. If specified, your service account will be used to process the data instead of the Fivetran-managed service account.

use_service_account.description: BigQuery use service account; default is false

use_workspace.description: Create and drop tables in a query results dataset. Default is false

workspace_same_as_source.description: Use the source dataset as the workspace dataset

schema_prefix.title: Destination schema prefix
schema_prefix.description: Destination schema prefix. Prefix for each replicated schema. For example with prefix 'x', source schemas 'foo' and 'bar' get replicated as 'x_foo' and 'x_bar'. The prefix is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation
